LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_ThinRations.label: thin rations
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_ThinRations.description: Carriers of this gene need less food than normal. Hunger still comes, and they can still starve.
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_ThinRations.customEffectDescri: Maximum nutrition need is 85% of normal
Hunger still comes, and starvation still kills
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_LargeLitter.label: large litter
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_LargeLitter.description: Carriers of this gene give birth to several young. The count falls between the set minimum and maximum, and the middle count is the most common.
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_LargeLitter.customEffectDescri: Birth count falls between the set minimum and maximum
The middle count is the most common, and the ends are less so
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_EarlyFertility.label: early fertility
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_EarlyFertility.description: Carriers of this gene can conceive once they reach the set age. Both partners must have reached that age. The usual life-stage limit no longer stops them.
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_EarlyFertility.customEffectDes: Can conceive after the set age
Both partners must have reached that age
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_HighFertility.label: high fertility
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_HighFertility.description: Carriers of this gene conceive at the set percent of the normal chance. The range is 100% to 1000%.
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_HighFertility.customEffectDesc: Pregnancy chance uses the set percent
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_RoomFertility.label: room fertility
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_RoomFertility.description: Carriers of this gene seek lovin' on their own. Conception is checked when lovin' ends, and it can happen while lactating. Both partners must be at least 1 year old.
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_RoomFertility.customEffectDesc: Conception is checked after lovin' ends
Both partners must be at least 1 year old
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_FastBirth.label: fast birth
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_FastBirth.description: Carriers of this gene have a shorter pregnancy. It can be as short as 3 days, and no longer than the vanilla lower bound.
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_FastBirth.customEffectDescript: Pregnancy is shortened to the set length
No longer than the vanilla lower bound
